content.text: {"name":"Composition_V02_V03_spread_lowT","hypothesis":"Groups with a higher V03 flow rate relative to V02 (cross-sectional z-score spread of 6-month averages) have higher next-month returns, and the effect is concentrated when T is low, reflecting a compositional shift between flows.","falsified_if":"Mean rank IC is zero or negative, or HAC t-statistic is below 1, or low-T IC is not larger than high-T IC in development statistics.","expression":"regime(spread(mavg(V03,6),mavg(V02,6)),\"low\")"}
